formDescription: Single-file upload popup. The user chooses one file with the file input, enters a required description, and clicks the Upload button. This upload popup does not identify what the uploaded file is for; that context must come from the current parent form step. Accepted extensions: .bmp, .dbf, .doc, .docx, .gif, .jpeg, .jpg, .mp4, .log, .pdf, .png, .pps, .ppsx, .ppt, .pptm, .pptx, .prj, .rtf, .sbn, .sbx, .shp, .shx, .tif, .tiff, .txt, .xls, .xlsx, .xml, and .zip. Maximum file size is 100 MB.

fullFileName.title: File Name:
fullFileName.description: File input used to choose one file for upload. Accepted file extensions and maximum size are listed in the form description.

Description.title: Description:
Description.description: Required description for the selected file. Maximum length is 500 characters.

Upload.title: Upload
Upload.description: Uploads the selected file and description.
